info.name: CollabSpace API Documentation & Collection
info.description:
Official REST API documentation and test suite for CollabSpace platform.

All protected endpoints require Bearer Token authorization. A pre-configured development token is included in the collection variables.

item.name: 01. Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for user registration, credential authentication, token rotation, social login, and password management.

request.description:
### Authenticate User

Authenticates user credentials and issues a JWT access token and rotating refresh token.

**Response:**
- `access_token`: JWT string for Bearer auth.
- `raw_refresh_token`: Refresh token string.
- `user`: Authenticated user entity.
Authenticates with Project Manager role credentials.

### Create User Account

Registers a new user and returns authenticated JWT credentials immediately.

**Body Parameters:**
- `name`: string (required)
- `email`: valid email (required, unique)
- `password`: min 8 chars (required)
- `password_confirmation`: matches password (required)
- `role`: `admin` | `project_manager` | `team_member` (optional, default `team_member`)

### Rotate Refresh Token

Exchanges an existing unexpired refresh token for a brand new access token and rotating refresh token.

### Terminate Session

Revokes the provided refresh token and invalidates the session.

### Send Password Reset Link

Sends a password reset token notification to the registered email address.

### Complete Password Reset

Updates user password using the token sent in the password reset notification.

### Exchange Google ID Token

Authenticates or registers a user via Google OAuth ID token, returning JWT credentials.

item.name: 02. Profile & Settings
item.description: User profile management, personal tasks, uploaded files, and activity logs.

request.description: Fetches current authenticated user profile, avatar, role, bio, and settings.
Updates user profile information, bio, phone, title, and availability status (`available`, `busy`, `away`, `offline`).

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Mohamed Salah",
    "phone": "+201012345678",
    "job_title": "Senior Frontend Engineer",
    "department": "Product Engineering",
    "bio": "Focusing on reactive components and micro-interactions.",
    "availability": "available"
}

request.description: Returns list of tasks assigned to or created by the current user.
Returns list of files uploaded by the current user.
Retrieves recent activities and actions performed by the current user.

item.name: 03. Dashboard
item.description: Analytics widgets, urgent items, summary metrics, and velocity charts.

request.description: Retrieves high-level counts: active projects, total tasks, upcoming meetings, unread chats.
Returns velocity and completion rate data for charts over time.
Returns list of currently active projects for quick widget display.
Retrieves the 5 most recently uploaded or accessed files.
Returns urgent and high-priority tasks requiring immediate attention.
Fetches team member availability list and contact status.
Returns upcoming scheduled meetings for the current user.

item.name: 04. Projects
item.description: Complete project lifecycle management, team allocations, sub-tabs, and project files.

request.description: Returns paginated list of projects accessible to the authenticated user.

Creates a new project.

**Body Parameters:**
- `name`: string
- `description`: text
- `status`: `planning` | `in_progress` | `on_hold` | `completed` | `archived`
- `priority`: `low` | `medium` | `high` | `urgent`
- `start_date`: YYYY-MM-DD
- `due_date`: YYYY-MM-DD

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Mobile App Redesign",
    "description": "Complete UX revamp of the iOS and Android client applications.",
    "status": "in_progress",
    "priority": "high",
    "start_date": "2026-10-01",
    "due_date": "2026-12-15"
}

request.description: Retrieves full details of a specific project.
Updates project information, dates, status, or description.
Permanently removes a project and associated records (subject to policy authorization).
Returns aggregated overview metrics, milestone stats, and team assignments for the project tab.
Returns assigned team members grouped by department or function.
Syncs department teams to a project.
Adds a user to the project member list.
Removes a user from project membership.
Retrieves the Kanban board columns (`todo`, `in_progress`, `review`, `completed`) scoped to this project.
Retrieves root files and folders attached to this project.
Uploads a document or media asset directly to the project directory.
Creates a new folder in the project directory.

item.name: 05. Tasks & Kanban
item.description: Kanban workflow, drag-and-drop status transitions, assignee management, reviewers, and discussions.

request.description: Fetches tasks with optional filtering by `project_id`, `status`, `priority`, or `assignee_id`.
Creates a new task in a project.

body.raw:
{
    "project_id": 1,
    "title": "Implement OAuth 2.0 PKCE Flow",
    "description": "Add PKCE support to mobile client authentication endpoints.",
    "priority": "high",
    "status": "todo",
    "due_date": "2026-11-01",
    "reviewer_id": 3,
    "assignees": [
        2
    ]
}

request.description: Retrieves task details with assignees, reviewer, activity history, and comments.
Updates task title, description, due date, priority, or reviewer.
Deletes a task.
Updates Kanban stage (`todo`, `in_progress`, `review`, `completed`) and column order.
Posts a comment/discussion reply on the task.
Updates the set of user IDs assigned to this task.
Assigns a project manager or peer reviewer to evaluate completed work.

item.name: 06. Real-Time Chat & Inbox
item.description: Direct messages (1-on-1), project channels, live socket broadcast messages, threads, and unread management.

request.description: Returns list of direct message conversations with latest message snippet and unread badges.
Finds or creates a 1-on-1 direct message channel with a user.
Retrieves all public/private chat channels belonging to project #1.
Creates a new topic or project channel.
Returns channel information, participant count, and membership status.
Fetches paginated message history for the channel.
Dispatches a message into the channel and broadcasts `ChatMessageSent` event.
Edits a previously posted message.
Soft-deletes or removes a message from the conversation.
Creates a threaded reply to a parent message.
Retrieves parent message and full thread conversation tree.
Resets unread counter for current user in this channel.
Toggles notification mute state on/off for this channel.

item.name: 07. Meetings & AI Summaries
item.description: Schedule meetings, calendar view, RSVP handling, live audio/speech transcripts, and automated AI summary generation.

request.description: Fetches scheduled meetings with date range filtering for monthly and weekly calendars.
Schedules a new meeting with participants and room link.

body.raw:
{
    "project_id": 1,
    "title": "Sprint 14 Planning & Retrospective",
    "description": "Review milestone achievements and allocate upcoming backlog.",
    "start_time": "2026-10-20 14:00:00",
    "end_time": "2026-10-20 15:30:00",
    "meeting_link": "https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij",
    "participants": [
        2,
        3
    ]
}

request.description: Provisions an authentic Google Meet room link using Google Meet API v2 (or compliant room code).
Checks current Google Meet API credentials, OAuth token validity, and live connectivity with Google Meet REST API v2.
Retrieves meeting room details, invitees, and current agenda status.
Updates meeting timing, room link, or agenda.
Cancels a scheduled meeting.
Responds with attendance status (`accepted`, `declined`, `tentative`).
Retrieves timestamped speech transcript segments recorded for this meeting.
Appends speech text to the meeting transcript stream and broadcasts to listeners.
Fetches generated executive meeting brief, discussion key points, and action items.
Synthesizes transcripts and meeting notes into action items, decisions, and summaries.

item.name: 08. Files & Storage
item.description: File inspection, secure downloads with auto-incrementing download telemetry, and folder navigation.

request.description: Retrieves file metadata: size, mime type, download count, uploader, and parent directory.
Downloads the raw file binary stream and automatically increments `downloads_count`.
Deletes file record and removes binary from underlying storage disk.
Retrieves folder details and lists child sub-folders and files within it.
Deletes directory and recursively manages child items.

item.name: 09. Reports & Analytics
item.description: Executive KPI summary metrics, comparison bar charts, progress area curves, worker activity lines, and report exports.

request.description: Returns top-level metric tiles: task completion rate, project velocity, and active team rate with percentage delta.
Returns on-time vs delayed completion metrics across projects for comparative bar charts.
Returns chronological completion percentage dataset for gradient area charts.
Returns team activity frequency and task completions per developer for line charts.
Retrieves previously generated report exports with download URLs.
Queues and compiles a detailed analytical report.
Fetches details and download status of a generated report.
Removes a generated report archive.

item.name: 10. AI Assistant
item.description: Intelligent conversational assistant, context injection, consultation sessions, and response feedback.

request.description: Returns list of user consultation sessions with latest message preview.
Initializes a new AI consultation session with an optional project context.
Retrieves conversation history and message stream.
Deletes consultation session and associated messages.
Sends a prompt to the assistant with project context and receives synthesized answer.
Records user rating or feedback on generated response (`helpful`, `not_helpful`).

item.name: 11. Notifications
item.description: In-app notification bell, live alerts, read/unread status management, and email notifications for tasks and meetings.

request.description: Retrieves paginated notifications for the authenticated user, including the total unread counter. Pass `unread=1` to filter unread alerts only.
Retrieves the count of unread notifications for badge rendering on the navbar bell icon.
Marks a single in-app notification as read.
Marks all pending unread notifications as read for the authenticated user.
Permanently removes or dismisses an in-app notification from the user's feed.
